items.title: This AI Tamagotchi Turns Everyday Objects Into Needy Virtual Pets
items.excerpt: A Carnegie Mellon student’s tiny E Ink gadgets, called OATs, give houseplants, skateboards, and dumbbells expressive personalities to nudge you toward better habits.
items.rationale: Freshest item in the pool: a new CMU E Ink object-companion device, a distinct design idea from the Mori lamp companion that ran in October.

items.title: The Xiaomi 18 Pro's rear displays support Google apps, Spotify, and custom GenAI apps
items.excerpt: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series' rear display is looking a lot more useful than initially thought, thanks to some clever apps.
items.rationale: New phone-hardware capability: user-made GenAI apps on a secondary rear screen, a new interface surface not covered before.

items.title: Apple Releases tvOS 27.2.1 With Siri AI for Older Apple TVs
items.excerpt: Apple today released tvOS 27.2.1, an update to the tvOS 27 operating system that launched in September. tvOS 27.2.1 comes nearly three weeks after Apple released tvOS 27.2. tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI support to the 2nd- and 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K models, but it is available for all Apple TV 4K m
items.rationale: Shipped software release that brings Siri AI to older Apple TV 4K hardware; the one Apple/Siri card allowed, and it is a new release, not commentary.

items.title: SlashVibe is an open-source workspace for AI agents, built to run your own code
items.excerpt: SlashVibe is an open-source AI agent desk controller with a Node.js and Python SDK. Kickstarter Early Bird is $189 ($249 retail), shipping March 2027.
items.rationale: New hardware launch: an open-source desk controller for AI agents with Node.js and Python SDKs. Builders can program it directly.

items.title: HP ZGX Fury packs in 748GB RAM and Nvidia GB300 — but prices start at $132,000
items.excerpt: This $132,000 workstation packs 748GB of memory and 400Gbps networking into a desk-side chassis — bringing data center AI hardware out of the cloud
items.rationale: New product with pricing: a desk-side GB300 workstation that runs data-center-class AI locally. It sits at the top end of the local-AI desktop trend and is a different machine from the Gigabyte and MSI boxes already covered.
